en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy urban street lined with multi‑story neoclassical buildings. People walk along the sidewalks and a few early to mid‑20th‑century cars are on the road. The perspective looks down a relatively narrow street with balconies, shop signs, and streetlights. Text along the bottom identifies the location as Gharib Pasha Street in Alexandria, and a small logo with a web address appears in the lower right.
